title: Fiddlehead

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fiddlehead is a raw balanced Ashlands food which is used in various recipes.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text:
Fiddleheads can be found in various ruined structures throughout the Ashlands biome, in particular inside Ashlands ruins. When picked, each fern produces 3 fiddleheads. Fiddleheads respawn every 5 hours.
Unlike some other pickable foods (e.g. Mushroom, Royal jelly), each pickable fiddlehead is located atop a fern bush; while the bush has 30 health and can be destroyed (dropping 1-2 Wood), this has no impact on the fiddlehead - which is not destructible and will continue to respawn even if its bush is destroyed. Note that the bush is weak to Chop damage, but resistant to Pierce and - usefully - immune to Fire, Poison and Spirit.
